method.circuit_source: local deterministic generators, not external benchmark suite artifacts
method.fq: strict Qiskit import; fresh Circuit.from_ir + state(refresh=True) + host export + endian normalization
method.aer: run(saved statevector circuit).result().get_statevector, CPU; fusion enabled
method.time_boundary: prepared representation to complete host statevector; includes object/job overhead, not kernel-only
method.first_call: per case in an already imported process; not fresh-process cold start
method.cache: new FQ Circuit every sample; refresh=True; 2 warmups by default
method.limitations: single-process small-case pilot; GPU vs CPU is not equal-hardware backend ranking; no adapter timing, shots, noise, dynamic tests or peak-memory measurement
